hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | grep -qiE 'sqlite3|event-recommender\.db' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"STOP: Before querying the candidates table, you MUST have read CLAUDE.md, section Database semantics. Key rules: (1) pipeline_state is the pipeline disposition column: values are text (pending_llm, vetoed, llm_rejected, written, expired) (2) llm_tier determines Notion eligibility, NOT tier. They often disagree: that is by design. (3) Some rows have pipeline_state=written AND llm_tier=Not Recommended: these are historical (LLM ran retrospectively on already-written events). Not a bug. (4) Before filtering on ANY column, run SELECT DISTINCT <column> FROM candidates to verify actual values. Do not assume from column names or docs."}}'
